summary: Iteration 19 — Vendor Audit Phase-1 PIVOT (AI Smart Upload) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 62/62 PASS (10 new tests in test_vendor_ai_extraction.py + 52 unchanged legacy in test_vendor_audit_e2e/rules/v3). Live-AI flow validated: GET /api/vendor-audit/meta/doc-types returns 7 statutory types incl. pf_ecr & esic_paid_challan; POST /upload-document accepts .xlsx/.pdf/.docx and rejects text/plain with 400; SHA-256 cache hit returns from_cache=true with cost_inr=0; GET /ai-documents strips file_b64; DELETE works; POST /run-ai requires >=1 doc (else 400) and produces ai_doc_count, ai_rows_count, totals + DOC001 'Missing document' findings for required-but-missing types (PF/ESIC); GET /cache/stats returns cached_extractions counter for admin. Validators unit verified valid/mismatch/unknown branches; combiner unit verified VENDOR_SHEET_COLUMNS row mapping. Frontend Playwright drove a fresh audit (AUG-2026 Maharashtra) end-to-end on the live preview URL: SmartUploadPanel hero ('Just upload your documents') + Auto-detect <select> (data-testid=ai-claimed-doc-type) + Upload document(s) button (ai-upload-btn) all rendered; uploaded /tmp/iter19_wage_iter19uniq.xlsx (5 KB wage register) → AI extracted 2 employees in ~12s with cost ₹0.13, ai-doc-{id} row showed filename + KB + 'detected: wage_register' + '2 employees' + status badge UNKNOWN (correct: wage_register is not one of the 7 statutory doc-types so validators report unknown — by design); run-ai-audit-cta clicked → page auto-switched to Findings tab showing 10 issues incl. 3 DOC001 missing-doc warnings (PF ECR, PF Paid Challan, ESIC Paid Challan) + 4 employee-level issues for Rahul S + 6 for Priya P; Audit Progress shows 3 steps (Upload Documents · Run AI Audit · Submit) with Upload + Run AI bars green after run; toggle-legacy-upload expanded the legacy panel and the original upload-excel-btn + upload-pf_ecr-btn re-appeared (backward compatibility intact); Module Switcher visible. Regression: Register Maker dashboard (rm-tab-overview) loads, HRMS admin dashboard ('Total Employees: 46') loads. Zero JS errors throughout.

critical_code_review_comments: vendor_audit/ai_extraction.py — confirm Sonnet-4.5 fallback path is exercised (current 10 tests only hit Flash happy-path). Add a test that simulates Flash failure (e.g., env-flagged stub) so the fallback branch has coverage before GA.

vendor_audit/routes.py — POST /upload-document stores full file_b64 in Mongo per AI doc (same risk previously flagged for register_maker data sheets). 25 MB × N audits × N docs will balloon Mongo; plan GridFS/S3 migration before production rollout.

vendor_audit/validators.py — wage_register isn't in the 7 statutory doc-types catalog, so the SmartUpload status badge always shows UNKNOWN for wage registers (functionally fine, but UX-wise a 'Wage Register' green/info badge would be clearer than the orange 'UNKNOWN'). Consider adding a 'wage_register' detected-type label distinct from 'unknown'.

Frontend AuditRunPage.js — 'Findings tab also has run-ai-audit-btn' is satisfied only when audit hasn't yet been run; once status=audited the testid disappears (verified in this run). If a re-run-from-Findings-tab UX is intended, gate visibility on locked instead of audit status.

Backend cross-tenant SHA-256 cache (cache_lookup/save) — confirm cache key includes file bytes hash only and NOT org_id, otherwise the 'cross-tenant dedup' claim is false. Add a test that uploads identical bytes from two different tenants and verifies both hit cache.
Files >700 lines guideline: AuditRunPage.js + routes.py likely now exceed 700 lines after the SmartUploadPanel additions — split SmartUploadPanel into its own component file.
